```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_scores_standard_deviations
title: >
  Describe the Scores One More Time
questions:
  - id: z_comparison
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Compare your answer
    prompt: >
      The easy test has a mean of 10 seconds and a standard deviation of 1 second.
      The hard test has a mean of 100 seconds and a standard deviation of 15
      seconds. Your times were 8 and 70 seconds. With this extra information,
      how would you describe your performances now? Why?
    hint: >
      How many standard deviations below the mean is each time?
    answer: >
      The easy-test time is 2 seconds below its mean: 2 ÷ 1 = 2 standard deviations.
      The hard-test time is 30 seconds below its mean: 30 ÷ 15 = 2 standard
      deviations. So although the times look very different, both performances
      are the same distance below their respective means in standard-deviation units.
```
